title: cli: `os environments create --clone-from` sends `clone_from_environment_id`, which the control plane never reads; drop it (ruled on cloud#1876)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud` execution seat (`repo:cloud#1`, session `session_01YSygzqVmrY31BnZge8KDo6`, R43). This card executes an existing maintainer ruling. It is not a new finding.

## The ruling

objectstack-ai/cloud#1876, record 5731589897 (director seat, summon #24, batch #165 item 1), maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-18T14:38Z:

> letter A, plus the CLI stops sending `clone_from_environment_id` now (… the CLI drops the field the control plane never read, and environment cloning becomes its own capability card cloud#2367)

The cloud half landed with PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2409, and cloud#1876 is closed. The CLI half is owed in this repository, and the cloud seat could not file it at the time: its environment refused issue creation. It was carried as a cross-repo owed item (cloud#1876 comments 5745816445 and 5746178487, and the maintainer inbox on objectstack#6026). It was never filed, and it has not been done.

## Measured on `main`

- `packages/cli/src/commands/environments/create.ts` still declares the flag `'clone-from': Flags.string({ description: 'Clone schema from an existing environment id' })`. It still sends `clone_from_environment_id: flags['clone-from']` in the create request, and the command's examples still show `--clone-from <source-id>`.
- The control plane strips the key unread. Cloud's `ProvisionEnvironmentRequestSchema` (`packages/service-tenant/src/spec/environment.zod.ts`) does not declare it, and its docblock records that undeclared keys are stripped by the `z.object` gate, "which is how `clone_from_environment_id` is accepted and ignored".
- Outside that docblock and one changeset, `git grep -niE "clone_from|cloneFrom"` over cloud `main` (`6e746cff`) finds nothing.

**Reach:** a user who runs `os environments create --clone-from X` gets a new, EMPTY environment and a success answer. Nothing says the clone did not happen.

## What to do

1. Remove the `--clone-from` flag, the `clone_from_environment_id` request key and the example line from `os environments create`.
2. Update any test or doc in this repository that names the flag.

The ruling did not specify whether a user who still passes the flag gets an "unknown flag" error from oclif or a dedicated message saying cloning is not available yet (cloud#2367). Oclif's default refusal is the smaller change.

⛔ Do not implement cloning. That is cloud#2367's capability decision, which is in the maintainer's decision box. When cloud#2367 lands, the CLI re-adds the flag against a server that honours it.

## Related

objectstack-ai/cloud#1876 (the ruling) · objectstack-ai/cloud#2367 (the cloning capability) · objectstack-ai/cloud#2409 (the cloud half).

Dedup terms: `clone_from_environment_id`, `--clone-from`, `environments create flag`, `unread request key`.
